Hello! I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. I'm glad you're here. 👋

Quickly, what I am:
- **Web app** — from a phone or computer on the same network, open https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate at https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). First visit lets you take the certificate; then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own messengers** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- **My own accounts** — I can register on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Everyday work** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?

Tell me which you prefer. Either way I'll stay agreeable and professional, and I won't put words in anyone's mouth.
